claims.text: The gps_trace governs the establishment test, and on it the excess is 0.85 km. trace_distance_km is 4.05 km against an optimal_distance_km of 3.2 km fixed by the routing engine at booking, which is 26.56% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates pass on the same excess: it is greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 4.0 is a convenience copy and may not be used, and the trace figure is cited for the threshold test.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretionary, because fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 6.0) x the surge_multiplier of 1.0 read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN) + 0.80 platform fee = 8.68. charged_total is 9.28, so the refund is 9.28 - 8.68 = 0.60. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor, so the outcome is not NO_ACTION, and it is 6.47% of charged_total, nowhere near the 90% full-refund share. Rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 the payable is SGD 0.60, and a PARTIAL_REFUND of that amount is the rider's remedy.

No traffic advisory on this record can excuse any part of the excess. EV-ADVIS-02846-01 carries admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING) and weight_multiplier 0.0, so it holds no payload and no advisory names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, carries a validity window, or is matched by a corridor departure and rejoin. POL-RD-03 is therefore unavailable and the driver's explanation ('Followed the app') is an assertion that cites no advisory identifier, so under POL-RD-13 the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an invoked-against-cited-artifact contradiction, POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged on this ground, and the explanation carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The absence itself is citable under POL-GEN-02 at weight 0.0.

POL-RD-04 cannot exclude a single metre of this excess. The chat_log for this trip carries 0 messages and is not truncated, so there is no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint for the platform to resolve, and nothing for the trace to corroborate or fail to corroborate. The rider-requested-detour route to exoneration is simply unavailable on the record, and no excess distance is set aside before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

POL-RD-05 cannot move the baseline away from the booked optimal of 3.2 km. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null, so no pin move, no different address and no platform-directed bay assignment is recorded. The optimal route to be re-applied is the one between the booked endpoints, and the measured excess stands as measured.

The trace is clean for policy purposes and carries the case on its own. EV-GPS-02846 holds 37 fixes at a 10 second sample interval with 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so none of the POL-RD-07 limbs (a) to (c) fires. Impairment is therefore not in issue, the excess is read straight off the trace, no independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names is required, and the mandatory escalation in POL-RD-10(3) is not triggered.

The rider carries and discharges the initial burden under POL-RD-08. The trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02846, and the trace opens at the recorded start of the metered trip, so the artifacts describe the same trip; the excess of 0.85 km / 26.56% meets the POL-RD-01 threshold and is measured on an unimpaired trace. The rider's profile shows deviation_claims_60d of 0, far below the threshold of 4 that would add a corroboration requirement under POL-RD-08, so no extra source is needed. The burden has shifted to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause under POL-RD-03, 04, 05, 11 or 12, and has pointed to none.

The matched-itinerary baseline of POL-RD-12 does not apply here. trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so no co-rider collection or set-down distance is excludable and the optimal route remains the booked engine figure of 3.2 km. The excess is not inflated by the pooling rules and stands at 0.85 km.

The deviation measured on this trip is not a MATERIAL deviation. The governing trace figure gives an excess of 0.85 km, and 26.56% of the 3.2 km optimal route — both well below the 8.0 km absolute and 50% proportional gates that POL-RD-01 sets for materiality. POL-RD-06 is therefore never engaged on this record: there is no route to a FULL_REFUND uplift of the whole $9.28 fare and no driver-conduct referral, and the remedy is confined to the POL-RD-02 arithmetic.

Even if the driver profile were consulted, the POL-RD-06 pattern test fails on the two fields the clause actually names: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 398, a ratio of 0.000 and far below both the 0.05 ratio test and the 3-flag alternative. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (value 1) is a different field, is context only under POL-GEN-01, and may not be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure; POL-GEN-01 is cited alongside POL-RD-06 as the constraint that forbids that substitution.

The rider's demand for the whole $9.28 fare is unsupported by the policy arithmetic. Under POL-RD-02 the recomputed fare is $8.68 — $3.80 base fare + $2.40 for the 3.2 km optimal distance at $0.75/km + $1.68 for the 6.0 optimal minutes at $0.28/min, times the surge multiplier of 1.00 read from the fare breakdown, plus the $0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, no fixed surcharge and no promo. The refund is therefore $9.28 − $8.68 = $0.60, which is 6.47% of the charged total and nowhere near the 90% share that would convert a partial into a full refund.

Nothing may be added on top of that figure. The fare breakdown carries no ERP charge at all — on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP totals are both $0.00 and erp_gantries is empty — and no airport surcharge is charged ($0.00), so POL-RD-09 yields no standalone pass-through correction on this trip. Under POL-RD-09(1) a pass-through line is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund and must never be added to it; adding anything here would double count a refund that the same ledger line already produced.

The distance the rider was actually billed for (4.0 km, meter charged at $0.75/km) is less than the length the trace records for the same run (4.05 km). The driver did not bill the rider for the whole measured distance, so the rider's monetary loss on the distance line is bounded by the fare difference the policy computes ($0.60), and cannot be stretched to the 0.85 km excess the rider's claim text implies.

On the absolute limb of POL-RD-01 the excess clears the 0.80 km floor by 0.05 km — 50 metres — and the driver's position is that the establishment test is not safely passed on this trace. The trace's own resolution is coarser than that margin: with a 10-second sample interval and the 34.2 to 45.8 kph speeds the trace itself records, consecutive fixes sit roughly 95 to 127 metres apart, so a 50 m margin is finer than the grid the measurement was taken on. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH establishment tests to pass, and where the only test in doubt is decided by a margin smaller than one fix interval of travel, the driver asks the Judge to find no deviation established and to leave the charge standing (NO_ACTION), the charge being $9.28 with $0.00 already refunded.

Trip TRP-02846. The driver's route was longer than the platform's optimal route by 0.85 km, and under POL-RD-01 that establishes a deviation. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02846): 4.05 km driven between the recorded trip start and the recorded completion. The booking-time optimal route is 3.2 km (EV-TRIP-02846, routing-engine-v3.2). The excess of 0.85 km is 26.56% of optimal, so both POL-RD-01 gates pass — greater than 0.80 km and greater than 20%. The rounded 4.0 km convenience copy on the trip record is not used for the threshold test, as POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure.

The driver's argument that the 0.05 km margin over the 0.80 km gate is finer than the trace's own fix spacing is rejected. POL-RD-01 states a strict numeric gate and supplies no tolerance keyed to sampling resolution, and the trace is not impaired: 37 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, so none of the POL-RD-07 limbs (a)–(c) fires. An excess of 0.85 km is greater than 0.80 km as the clause requires.

The deviation is not MATERIAL (26.56% is below 50% and 0.85 km is below 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged by materiality. Even if the driver profile is consulted, the pattern test fails on the fields the clause names: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 398. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (value 1) is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used against the driver. There is accordingly no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. POL-RD-12 also does not apply: vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so the baseline stays the booked 3.2 km.

Nothing excuses any part of the excess. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02846) carries 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour exists under POL-RD-04. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and both amended optimal figures null, so POL-RD-05 does not move the baseline. No traffic advisory exists: EV-ADVIS-02846-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the driver's statement 'Followed the app' cites no advisory identifier and carries no weight; under POL-RD-13(1) the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. The rider discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden (all three artifacts carry trip_id TRP-02846; the excess meets the threshold on an unimpaired trace; rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, below the corroboration trigger of 4), and the driver pointed to no artifact and no clause under POL-RD-03, 04, 05, 11 or 12.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. charged_total is 9.28 (EV-FARE-02846). recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 × 3.2 optimal km + 0.28 × 6.0 optimal min) × the surge multiplier of 1.00 read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN) + 0.80 platform fee = (3.80 + 2.40 + 1.68) + 0.80 = 8.68. Refund = 9.28 − 8.68 = 0.60. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor and is 6.47% of charged_total, far below the 90% share that would convert it to a full refund. Rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 the payable is SGD 0.60.

Nothing is added on top. The fare breakdown carries no ERP charge (on-route and off-route ERP totals are both 0.00 and erp_gantries is empty) and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 yields no standalone pass-through correction, and POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding a pass-through line to the POL-RD-02 figure.

On the driver's side there is no unbilled-distance compensation: the billed 4.0 km falls short of the trace's 4.05 km by only 0.05 km, far below the 1.0 km shortfall POL-RD-04 requires. driver_compensation_sgd is null.

The outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 0.60 to the rider. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor; the deciding facts are carried by weight-1.0 artifacts (EV-GPS-02846, EV-TRIP-02846, EV-FARE-02846), so no discount applies and no POL-RD-10 trigger fires. No clause produces a referral. The monetary effect (SGD 0.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

Establishment (POL-RD-01). The governing distance is the trace figure on EV-GPS-02846, 4.05 km, not the rounded 4.0 km convenience copy on the trip record. Against the booking-time optimal of 3.2 km on EV-TRIP-02846 the excess is 0.85 km, or 26.56% of optimal. Trace integrity (POL-RD-07). EV-GPS-02846 carries 37 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds. None of limbs (a) to (c) fires, so the trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, the excess is read straight off it, no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is needed, and POL-RD-10(3) is not triggered.

Materiality and the driver profile (POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01). The excess is not MATERIAL - it is below both 50% of optimal and 8.0 km - so POL-RD-06 is not engaged and no driver-conduct referral and no full-fare uplift arise. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and cannot be substituted for the trailing-90-day counter.

Remedy (POL-RD-02). fare_model on EV-FARE-02846 is METERED, so the refund is arithmetic. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 3.2 km optimal + 0.28 x 6.0 optimal minutes) x the surge multiplier of 1.00 read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 8.68. charged_total is 9.28; refund = 9.28 - 8.68 = 0.60. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor and 6.47% of charged_total, far short of the 90% that would convert this into a FULL_REFUND. The rider's demand for the whole 9.28 fare is therefore not supported; the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 0.60.

Pass-through lines (POL-RD-09). EV-FARE-02846 carries no ERP charge at all (on-route and off-route ERP totals both 0.00, erp_gantries empty) and no airport surcharge (0.00), so no standalone pass-through correction arises, and POL-RD-09(1) would in any event forbid adding such a line on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

Exculpation. POL-RD-04 cannot exclude any distance: EV-CHAT-02846 holds 0 messages and is not truncated, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint for the trace to corroborate or fail to corroborate. POL-RD-05 cannot move the baseline: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and the amended-optimal distance and duration are both null. Confidence. The deciding facts - the trace distance, the booking-time optimal, and the fare ledger arithmetic - all rest on artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0 (EV-GPS-02846, EV-TRIP-02846, EV-FARE-02846). On the driver's claims: the deviation is not a MATERIAL one (excess 0.85 km against 3.2 km optimal is 26.56%, below the 50% and 8.0 km materiality gates), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral arise — and the profile confirms it, because driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 398 (EV-DPROF-02846). The driver's closing argument — that a 0.05 km margin over the 0.80 km floor is finer than one fix interval, so the deviation should not be found and the charge left standing — is rejected: POL-RD-01 sets a numeric gate and the clause provides no discount for measurement resolution. The rider's claim for the whole $9.28 is also rejected, because POL-RD-02 makes the refund arithmetic rather than discretionary. The measurement: POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace the governing figure. EV-GPS-02846 runs 4.05 km against the 3.2 km optimal fixed at booking on EV-TRIP-02846 — an excess of 0.85 km, or 26.56% of optimal; both establishment gates (>20% and >0.8 km) pass, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The trip_record.actual_distance_km of 4.0 may not be cited for the threshold test (it would give exactly 0.80 km and fail the 'greater than' gate); that is why POL-RD-01 says the trace governs. No exculpatory clause applies. There are no chat messages (EV-CHAT-02846), so POL-RD-04 is unavailable; no pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded on EV-TRIP-02846, so POL-RD-05 does not run; the fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not run; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not run. The driver's 'Followed the app' stands on no advisory record: EV-ADVIS-02846-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and, under POL-RD-13, that assertion carries no weight while remaining a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The refund: under POL-RD-02, recomputed_fare = ($3.80 + $0.75 × 3.2 km + $0.28 × 6.0 min) × the surge multiplier of 1.00 read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN, plus the $0.80 platform fee, no ERP, no surcharge, no waiting fee and no promo = $8.68. charged_total $9.28 − recomputed_fare $8.68 = a refund of $0.60, which is above the $0.50 de minimis floor and 6.47% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share; rounded up to the nearest $0.05 it is $0.60, so the result is PARTIAL_REFUND of $0.60. POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top: EV-FARE-02846 carries no ERP lines and no airport surcharge, so no standalone pass-through correction arises. No driver-conduct referral is produced.

THE REFUND (POL-RD-02, fare model METERED):
- charged_total = SGD 9.28 (EV-FARE-02846)
- recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 6.0) x 1.00 surge, read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN EV-FARE-02846) + 0.80 platform fee = 8.68
- refund = 9.28 - 8.68 = 0.60, rounded up to SGD 0.60.
That is above the 0.50 de minimis and 6.47% of the charged total, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND and not a full one. The monetary effect (SGD 0.60) is below the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold and executes on issue, subject to the appeal route.

NO EXCULPATORY CLAUSE APPLIES. POL-RD-04 fails: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02846) holds no messages, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint for the trace to corroborate. POL-RD-05 fails: no pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded and the amended optimal fields are null. POL-RD-12 does not apply: the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-03 is unavailable: the traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02846-01) is MISSING, weight 0.0, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING) and no payload, so no advisory names a road, window or corridor departure. The driver's response 'Followed the app' asserts no traffic cause and cites no advisory identifier, so it carries no weight and no POL-RD-10(5) escalation follows: the missing artifact is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact. It carries no fact and does not enter the confidence cap; it is named only for transparency.

THE TRACE IS NOT IMPAIRED FOR POLICY PURPOSES: 37 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec of 0.0 (EV-GPS-02846), so POL-RD-07 does not bite and no independent corroboration is required. On the pass-throughs, the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02846) carries no ERP line and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 yields nothing to add; nothing may be added on top of the POL-RD-02 refund in any event.

The driver is right that the meter billed 4.0 km while the trace shows 4.05 km, but the shortfall is 0.05 km, far below the 1.0 km that would open POL-RD-04's driver-compensation limb, so no compensation is payable.

Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor. The deciding facts rest on artifacts at full weight (trip record, GPS trace, fare breakdown); the only uncertainty is the narrow 0.05 km by which the absolute gate is cleared.
